assets.subject: the Mochi Chef from the first attached picture, shown in five views
assets.details: Exactly the same character, proportions, clay material and colours as the first attached picture: a soft ivory steamed-dumpling body with pleats gathered at the top, a white puffy chef's hat, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, a small closed smile and soft peach blush on both cheeks. The face never changes: the eyes stay closed arcs and the mouth stays the same small closed smile. No arms, no hands, no legs and no feet. From left to right: 1) facing the viewer; 2) three-quarter view turned to the viewer's left; 3) side profile facing left, with one closed eye arc, part of the smile and one cheek visible; 4) three-quarter back view turned to the left, no face visible; 5) back view, the hat and gathered pleats seen from behind, no face. Ignore any words in the pictures.
assets.approved: Approved by the owner in chat, 27 Oct 2026, for the Mochi kitchen page. Used: runs/kitchen raw-1.

assets.subject: a big plump coral floor cushion
assets.details: A big, overstuffed round floor cushion (a plump pouf) for a tiny round dumpling chef to sit on, soft and squashy like a marshmallow. A thick rounded disc about 40% as tall as it is wide, its top gently domed, with a deep tufted centre button that pulls the fabric into soft radial gathers and eight puffy segments around it, a neat piped seam running round its rounded side, and fine visible fabric texture like brushed cotton velvet with tiny soft highlights. Soft contact shading where its base meets the floor. Seen from the front and slightly above (about 25 degrees), the whole cushion visible. Empty: nothing on it. A plain object only: no face, no eyes, no mouth. Warm coral pink fabric with a cream button and cream piping.
assets.approved: Approved by the owner in chat, 27 Oct 2026, for the Mochi kitchen page. Used: runs/kitchen-nook2 raw-2.

assets.subject: the same coral floor cushion, squashed where someone sits
assets.details: Exactly the same cushion as the attached cushion picture (same colour, velvet fabric, puffy segments, piping and button), but now squashed under the weight of an invisible round dumpling-shaped sitter: the cushion is flatter, about 30% as tall as it is wide, and slightly wider, its rounded sides bulging outward; the middle of the top is pressed down into a wide, deep, soft round hollow about 70% of the cushion's width, the velvet pulled into soft wrinkles and creases that radiate out from the hollow, the button sunk out of sight at its bottom, and the stuffing pushed up into a puffy raised ridge around the back and sides of the hollow. The near front rim of the hollow stays round and plump. Same viewpoint and lighting as the attached cushion. Empty: nobody on it, no character, only the squashed cushion. A plain object only: no face, no eyes, no mouth.
